Show less Read more Like 1 Dislike Reply Comments 40 Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam In this video Transcript Description Bengals OFFICIALLY Sign Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins to Historic Contracts | Enter the Jungle The Cincinnati Bengals have given a contract extension to the highest-paid non-quarterback in the NFL. Wide receiver Ja'Marr Chase signed his four-year, $161 million contract extension with the Bengals on Tuesday. Tee Higgins also inked a fresh new contract with the Bengals this week as he sticks with Cincinnati through the 2028 NFL season on a four-year, $115 million deal that ranks higher than all other No. 2 wide receiver contracts in the league. James Rapien and Andrew Fox Miller react to their latest press conference, thoughts on Joe Burrow, the offense and more! LISTEN wherever you get your podcasts!
